steps.en: The e-reminder was sent or the offender opted out
steps.id: Pengingat elektronik terkirim atau offender memilih tidak menerimanya
steps.why_en: The opt-out check exists, but the job is switched off and nothing links its result to the next step.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan opt-out ada, tetapi job-nya dimatikan dan hasilnya tidak dihubungkan ke langkah berikutnya.

steps.en: OCMS selects local NRIC holders due for the second letter
steps.id: OCMS memilih pemegang NRIC lokal yang akan menerima surat kedua

steps.en: FIN, company and passport holders are also checked
steps.id: Pemegang FIN, perusahaan, dan passport juga dicek
steps.why_en: The FIN and company check is switched off in the settings, and passport holders have no check.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan FIN dan perusahaan dimatikan di pengaturan, dan pemegang passport tidak punya pengecekan.

steps.en: OCMS sends IDs to MHA and updates the offender's details
steps.id: OCMS mengirim ID ke MHA dan meng-update data offender
steps.why_en: An open ticket reports that MHA cannot process piled-up files, and the connection cannot be checked here.
steps.why_id: Ada tiket terbuka yang melaporkan MHA tidak bisa memproses file yang menumpuk, dan koneksinya tidak bisa dicek di sini.

steps.en: The notice is ready for the second letter
steps.why_en: The next stage is set, but letters run only by manual trigger and the vendor upload is blocked.
steps.why_id: Stage berikutnya sudah diset, tetapi surat hanya jalan lewat trigger manual dan upload ke vendor diblokir.
